title: ForgeTrain: Forging Production-Grade Training Frameworks via Harness-Driven AI Development
abstract: arXiv:2609.13645v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Training large models still relies on general-purpose frameworks such as Megatron-LM, whose generality tax constrains scenario-specific optimization and adds runtime overhead through accumulated abstraction. AI code generation reduces the cost of building a framework, and makes it affordable to forge one per scenario. We propose Forge Engineering: building a dedicated implementation from scratch for each scenario and iteratively optimizing it toward peak performance under correctness and usability constraints. Dedicated implementations inherit no abstraction boundaries, so they can integrate optimizations across the stack and reach a higher performance ceiling. We instantiate this paradigm for training frameworks as ForgeTrain, which holds a trusted framework as a golden reference and relaxes equivalence monotonically from Bit-for-Bit to Surpass. Experiments across multiple model--hardware configurations show that ForgeTrain consistently

translated_title: ForgeTrain：通过Harness驱动的AI开发锻造生产级训练框架
translated_abstract: 训练大模型仍然依赖于Megatron-LM等通用框架，其“通用性税”限制了针对特定场景的优化，并通过累积的抽象层带来运行时开销。AI代码生成降低了构建框架的成本，使得为每个场景定制一个框架变得可行。我们提出了“锻造工程”范式：为每个场景从头构建专用实现，并在正确性和可用性约束下迭代优化至峰值性能。专用实现不继承任何抽象边界，因此能够跨技术栈整合优化，达到更高的性能上限。我们将这一范式在训练框架上实例化为ForgeTrain，它以一个可信框架作为黄金参考，并从比特级一致单调地放宽等价性要求直至实现性能超越。在多种模型-硬件配置上的实验表明，ForgeTrain始终……
tldr: 该论文提出“锻造工程”新范式并实现ForgeTrain系统，利用AI代码生成为每个训练场景从头锻造专用训练框架，以可信框架为黄金参考、将等价性从比特级一致逐步放宽到性能超越，从而突破通用框架的性能天花板。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes "Forge Engineering" and its instantiation ForgeTrain, which uses AI code generation to forge a dedicated production-grade training framework from scratch for each scenario—holding a trusted framework as a golden reference and monotonically relaxing equivalence from bit-for-bit to surpassing—thereby breaking the performance ceiling of general-purpose frameworks.
